placements.title: Team routines run on a fixed cadence with an agreed start
placements.frame: What routine does this expression set, on what cadence or threshold does it run, who carries it, and from when does it take effect?
placements.why: The position holds the fortnightly intake rota with overlap hand-offs, the restock threshold, and the shared 1 November start. All of these are operating routines for the team. None of the three existing leaves (anti-Slack positioning, decision capture, decisions evaporating) covers operating rhythm, so this is a new standalone theme. Future envelopes about rotas, thresholds, and start dates can keep feeding it.
